comment: save.c savelev_core() runs dmonsfree() when iflags.purge_monsters is set, so a game saved with monsters that died since the last movemon() restores without them. #wizloadlua Wiz-loca on Dlvl 1 makes statue traps, whose mk_trap_statue() sends each donor monster away with mongone(); saving at once leaves those deaths pending. After the restore, movemon()'s dmonsfree() finds nothing pending. Seed, date, character and inputs chosen independently.
